Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms

Hi Jessica —

Great speaking yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a first-pass DPA with a couple of Marketplace-specific notes pulled into the cover letter so Microsoft has visibility. Also attaching the quote for the Reserved Private Plan (term: 12 months).

Quick asks:
- Can your legal team confirm whether Stratus requires a different data residency addendum (we flagged US-only)?
- Any firm travel or SOC evidence requirements beyond what’s in the DPA?

We’ve looped in Aditya (legal) and Camila (finance) to keep redlines moving. If we can land a DPA + Marketplace offer language this week we can proceed to MS co-sell onboarding and procurement PO.

Attachments: Stratus_DPA_redlines_20270321.docx (proposed redlines), Marketplace_Quote_Mar2027.pdf

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0197


From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@stratushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Liu <mliu@stratushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the packet. Quick read-through from our side:
- We need the indemnity cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months rather than a flat $5M. Can you check if Redwood will accept a 12-month/contract-fees cap?
- Our procurement team needs explicit language that logs/audit evidence can be retained for up to 24 months for regulatory review.
- Microsoft will require us to accept certain Marketplace terms — are you able to provide the canonical Marketplace clause you’ll present to MS?

Looping Mark (counsel) to coordinate redlines. We can set an internal procurement PO target for mid-April if the DPA is acceptable.

-Jessica
Director, Vendor Contracts | Stratus Health
jessica.park@stratushealth.com | 617-555-4120

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms

Jessica —

Appreciate the quick read. Attached is a redline that attempts to address your points:
- Indemnity cap: counterproposal ties cap to fees paid in prior 12 months with a floor of $1M and ceiling of $4M. Aditya suggested this as a compromise to avoid an open-ended liability for Redwood.
- Logs/audit retention: we accepted 24 months for audit artifacts; added section 4.3 to clarify scope (transactional logs only, not raw model telemetry).
- Marketplace clause: included a Marketplace cover letter (page 2) that mirrors the wording Redwood submits to Microsoft during offer creation. That should surface the co-sell contract dependencies.

Camila added a short note on invoicing cadence and PO references to ensure the quote matches Stratus’s procurement system (see last page of the quote).

If Mark has markup we’ll ask Aditya to take legal ownership and propose final language. If all looks reasonable we can route for signature and then request MS onboarding — I’ll coordinate the co-sell packet with ms-marketplace@microsoft.com.

Attachments: Stratus_DPA_redlines_20270321.docx (redline v2)

Best,

Lauren
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms

Lauren / Jessica / Aditya —

Attached are our markups. Two items in particular: 1) we continue to push for a cap equal to 12 months of fees without an added floor/ceiling (Stratus policy); 2) the Microsoft Marketplace acceptance clause needs explicit confirmation that any marketplace-specific pass-through terms will not enlarge Redwood’s indemnity exposure to third parties. Please confirm Redwood will keep liability limited to direct damages and will not accept vicarious liabilities arising solely from Marketplace acceptance.

We also flagged an exhibit request for an SOC-2 Type II report and a certification timeline; if Redwood can provide the latest report and a short attestation letter, that will materially speed internal approvals.

Regards,
Mark Liu
Senior Counsel | Stratus Health
mliu@stratushealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mark Liu <mliu@stratushealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms

Mark / Jessica —

Thanks for the notes. A few responses from Redwood legal: 
- Indemnity cap: we can accept linkage to 12 months of fees but must retain a reasonable upper bound for enterprise risk management. Proposal: cap = min(12 months of fees, $3.5M). This narrows the gap vs your ask while addressing our board/risk constraints.
- Marketplace pass-through: Redwood will accept that Marketplace-required pass-through terms are limited in scope. We will not accept vicarious liabilities that convert Marketplace administrative steps into expanded indemnities. We added clarifying language in §7.2.
- SOC-2: latest Type II report (2026) is available; I’ve asked security to prepare an attestation letter and we’ll deliver via secured SharePoint link.

If Stratus can confirm acceptance of the cap ceiling we’ll prep the final DPA for signature. Also proposing a short alignment call Wednesday to close commercial items and agree next steps for MS onboarding.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Health — Azure Private Plan DPA & Marketplace terms — next steps

Team —

Quick summary from today’s thread and proposed next steps:
1) Indemnity: Redwood proposes cap = min(12 months of paid fees, $3.5M). Aditya confirmed marketplace pass-through language limits vicarious exposure.
2) Audit/SOC: Redwood will deliver SOC 2 Type II (2026) + attestation by EOD Thu 3/25 via secure link.
3) Marketplace: I’ll submit the Marketplace offer with the attached cover letter and request co-sell registration; ms-marketplace@microsoft.com is on copy to start onboarding.
4) Procurement timing: once DPA is signed, Camila will issue the final quote and invoice instructions; target PO mid-April.

Can I get a confirmation from Mark/Jessica that the cap proposal is acceptable so we can circulate the signature packet tomorrow? If yes, I’ll push the MS packet and loop MS onboarding.

Thanks all —

Lauren Bishop
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachments referenced earlier: Stratus_DPA_redlines_20270321.docx, Marketplace_Quote_Mar2027.pdf
